method.environment: staging data; disposable APIs on the existing private Docker bridge
method.order: ABBA: baseline, response-only, response-only, baseline; fresh API for each phase
method.transport: Uncompressed HTTP, new connection per request, no TLS/Nginx/browser; cannot compare absolute times with previous published HTTPS cohort
method.load: Concurrency at most 2; dispatch at most 2 requests/second; same selected admin, routes, data, image and API resource limits
method.flags: Baseline: all new caches off. Response: master/response true, monthly/reference/progress false, 15-second TTL. Existing legacy TTL caches retained in both modes.
method.warmup: Three traversals of six routes per phase excluded. First navigation recorded separately, two observations per mode/case, no cold p95.
method.databaseInstrumentation: Pool.query calls only; query wall includes scheduling/pool wait, excludes transaction Client.query and is not PostgreSQL execution time
method.correlation: Exact numeric test request ID per phase joins each of 1200 client samples to exactly one HTTP server event
method.cpu: Temporary API cgroup usage_usec delta across measured phase, includes request logging and health overhead; excludes PostgreSQL/worker/other apps
method.cpuProtection: Pause dispatch after five >=50% host steal samples; resume after five <35%; one seven-second pause, no discarded slow samples
method.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.95. Summary p95 only with >=100 observations; hit/miss/first-navigation subsets remain exploratory
method.limitations: Sequential phases, shared VPS, unequal steal, one admin and one selected project/group; no write invalidation, permission-profile, broad-load, browser, production or 24h/7-day acceptance

deployedSmoke.surface: existing deployed backend over Docker bridge
